summary: Iteration 6 frontend testing. Verified removal of simulation panel & detail-page challenge/discovery boxes, and new editable CodeEditor + SchematicPanel + hardware Web Serial controls. All flows pass with 0 console errors on desktop (1920x900) and mobile (400x800).

test_results.removed_content_all_absent: PASS (detail-challenge, detail-discovery, exec-mode-switch, exec-mode-simulation, exec-mode-hardware, simulation-panel, sim-run-button, sim-reset-button, virtual-serial, code-panel all count=0)
test_results.editor_persistence_localStorage_key_embe: PASS (draft restored after full reload + renavigate)
test_results.hardware_controls: PASS (controls, baud, connect enabled [Web Serial supported in this Chromium], flash disabled until connected, clear, status='DISCONNECTED', monitor)
test_results.cross_module_isolation: PASS (module 2 does not contain module 0 draft; own placeholder shown)

notes: Header live search input was not queried via [data-testid=header-search-input] (not part of the primary new-feature checklist); other regression flows (sidebar, donation, tabs) render fine. No sign of regression.
hardware-connect was enabled in the automation Chromium (Web Serial reported supported). Clicking it did not throw and did not surface a picker in headless mode — as expected/accepted per spec.
critical_code_review_comments: CodeEditor.jsx and SchematicPanel.jsx duplicate a small localStorage map-load/save helper pattern — could be extracted into a tiny shared hook (usePerModuleStorage) if more panels are added later. Not blocking.
Schematic images are stored as data URLs in localStorage — large uploads can quickly exceed the ~5MB quota; consider adding a file-size guard and user-facing error toast.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-6 acceptance criteria verified. Removed selectors are confirmed absent; new selectors (code-editor-wrap, code-editor-shell, .code-editor-textarea, editor-reset-button, editor-copy-button, hardware-controls/baud/connect/flash/clear/status/monitor, schematic-panel/placeholder/upload-cta/upload-input/image/zoom-button/clear-button/lightbox) all work.
